verdicts.reason: Both have the same structural problems. The white card runs into the top, left and right canvas edges, so the original's inset rounded panel is lost and the dune art shrinks to a thin strip. The See Fares CTA sits above the headline, which breaks the reading order. A big empty white gap separates the CTA/logo from the headline, and the CTA's left edge doesn't line up with the headline. A is slightly less bad because the CTA and logo at least share one row. In B they are staggered at different heights for no reason, which adds another misalignment and makes the top look scattered.
